name: Planar Ally

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ask a power you serve to send a Celestial, Elemental or Fiend to help you.
text: The creature isn't compelled to obey; you bargain with it, usually paying for a service in gold or deeds, and it may refuse unreasonable or dangerous requests.
